title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics; parity + v1.28.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth behavior, retry ergonomics, and streaming API ergonomics ahead of the v1.28.0 release. This PR unifies the auth token refresh flows, consolidates retry/backoff primitives across SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics (cancellable streams, unified event shapes), and syncs minor surface differences (naming, arg order) discovered during integration tests. Changes: - Python: add AuthSession class to centralize token refresh hooks, expose `retries` config object with backoff policy and jitter, improve streaming iterator to support explicit cancel() and contextmanager usage. - TypeScript: adopt same `AuthSession` concept (AuthClient) with automatic token refresh and improved typing for streaming events; replace legacy onMessage callback with async iterable and Event type union. - Go: add AuthSession struct, refactor RetryPolicy to match Python/TS semantics, add StreamCloser interface for graceful cancellation. - Tests: add cross-SDK integration tests for token expiry and retry/stream behavior using local mock server. - Docs & Changelog: migration notes for v1.28.0 and code examples in quickstarts. Checklist: - [x] Implement AuthSession in Python/TS/Go - [x] Unify retry/backoff API shapes - [x] Streaming ergonomics and tests - [x] Update docs and changelog - [x] Bump SDK versions to v1.28.0 Notes: migration required only for advanced users who depended on previous low-level stream callback shapes; default behavior remains backward-compatible for common patterns. Linear refs: ENG-2134 (SDK parity), ENG-2209 (streaming ergonomics).
